Still open: no LIT-compatible workflow for DXIL-validator tests exists -- tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/validation/ (~150 %dxilver/%dxv FileCheck tests) remains excluded from lit discovery (config.suffixes = [], set by #5537 Aug 2023), confirmed via lit --show-tests (0 tests found); only reachable via a manual, one-directory-at-a-time hcttest.cmd -filecheck / TAEF CompilerTest::ManualFileCheckTest invocation, not check-all/CI; tests still being added there as recently as #6172 (Jan 2024). A separate, newer tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheckLit/ tree shows a partial LIT migration exists for HLSL codegen tests generally, but has no validation subdirectory. Resolved: the follow-up comment's narrower ask for external-validator-workflow test coverage -- tools/clang/test/DXC/validate_1_6_2112.test, validate_1_7_2308.test, validate_1_8_2502.test, version_interface.test now cover loading an external/older validator via DxcDllExtValidationLoader and are genuinely lit-discovered, added by #7749 (2025-10-27) and fixed by #8075 (2026-01-22).
